race.description: Sportsbet Fixed Odds Exotics F&M Hcp (Bm74)
race.comment: SISTER SHAY (2) made nice improvement second up at Wagga in a decent race there, just edged out as favourite. Peaks now and her form last time in reads well for this. She's up to these and the each way quote appeals. BEFUDDLE (7) is going well, following up a fresh win with two close-up efforts. Backs up quickly from Saturday behind Karren, she'll roll forward and prove very hard to run down. LEGACY BAY (10) has ability but can be hit or miss. She's up to this at her best and does go very well over this track and trip. THE VOLTA (8) has been contesting some stronger races and will take holding out with even luck from the low gate.
